failureExplanation.actualGate: All four indexed cases have 2 direct candidates and insufficient verdict; no direct.traversal phase. The new canonical-source proof was attempted but did not establish sufficient evidence.
failureExplanation.metadata: Two pristine v1 facts share the original exact canonical user assertion. The prefers-as-favorite projection is outside neutralLiteralProjection and is not an exact copula literal. This matches the observed insufficient result; metadata is not an exact search-row payload receipt.
failureExplanation.fastEmpty: Governed embedding and terminal ledger finish before the 750 ms retrieval origin. The retrieval origin then spans prepareReads, ANN and readMatches+delivery. Actual 848 ms exceeded 750; source checks precede seed binding and BFS selection. Existing ranking-pinned late retention only preserves already selected items; it cannot recover zero accepted/selected items. Logs do not pinpoint the exact first deadline check or per-read contribution.
failureExplanation.noRepairClaim: No controlled comparison or prospective savings claim; current proof never produced a direct route in these four cases.
failureExplanation.factPermissionBoundary: contextSourceBatch witness permission labels do not prove canViewFacts: contextSourceHandler uses getSource(sourceId) without permission; traverse bind performs the explicit fact-permission guard. Vector hydration explicitly requests canViewMemories. No authorized fact prefix is inferred before traversal.

bottleneckRanking.finding: Semantic fallback makes governed query embedding plus admission/capture/attach serial before retrieval; indexed context Action spans 1609/2241/2847/2702 ms.
bottleneckRanking.implication: The native model embedding itself is only about 295-335 ms. All governance transactions must retain their original durable boundaries. A valid source proof can avoid this whole secondary billable path; an arbitrary grammar expansion is not established as safe or sufficient.

bottleneckRanking.finding: Repeated selected-transcript hydration, provenance/source checks and candidate assembly occur in every fresh native snapshot and several times inside saveAndPrepare; measured docs/read bytes grow with history.
bottleneckRanking.implication: This is a source-grounded CPU/read/serialization investigation target, not proof that all growth is one query or one removable boundary. Same-transaction helpers already share bounded raw metadata/messages/graph rows; current source/authority verdicts still rerun.

bottleneckRanking.finding: Browser submit envelope plus independent post-I/O session and subsequent observe/session delivery gates consume measured serial intervals.
bottleneckRanking.implication: These overlap backend work and cannot be summed with native spans. Fresh session checks preserve revocation/scope correctness and are not proposed for removal.

bottleneckRanking.finding: First Gateway text follows main admission by about 447-570 ms; visibility and durable first output add two serial mutations before visible delivery.
bottleneckRanking.implication: This is smaller than indexed pre-dispatch work. A future atomic publication design would require pre-enqueue fence, exact-attempt binding and sink-prefix dedup; it is not approved by this analysis.

additionalSourceCandidate.candidate: Private native preparation may pass already loaded immutable selected-transcript rows and scoped current-state projections to its local helpers while still executing every original ordered predicate and invalidating on writes, instead of repeatedly entering full executionContext from completed-step, two resolution helpers, begin/start and post-selection preparation.
additionalSourceCandidate.evidence: saveAndPrepareContextV8 is one mutation; source makes at least eight executionContext calls on the ordinary uncompleted path (save=1, prepare=1, completed=1, resolve=2, post-selection=1, begin=1, start=1). Each hydrateSelectedCutoff enters two full history passes and owner-source checks. Current raw message/bridge caches mean not every pass issues a physical read.
additionalSourceCandidate.status: Source-supported bounded candidate for investigation; no safe elimination or significant savings is proven. Mutable account/attempt/output, grant/deadline, consumed-source and write invalidation predicates cannot be replaced by a retained verdict. No implementation or new acceptance requested.

missingMeasurements: No exact per-read duration for currentRead, vector/fact source eligibility, traversal bind or final delivery; no precise expiry-check event.
Native executionTime/userExecutionTime are official runtime fields, not database CPU/network decompositions. No Gateway-internal/provider/region routing breakdown.
No exact native-to-client RPC correlation ID or synchronized browser/server monotonic clock; remaining browser delivery interval cannot be assigned to transport versus scheduler versus UI.
Normal/High/Max differ in history size, effort and ambient service timing; this is an observed chain, not an isolated depth scaling experiment.
